# Navigation icons

The navigation uses five Lucide icons: `users-round`, `calendar-days`,
`message-circle`, `user-round`, and `layout-dashboard`.

Original SVGs and their SHA-256 hashes are retained here in
`source-manifest.json`. Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide
and https://lucide.dev. The license is retained both here and with the
packaged icons in `miniprogram/assets/navigation/LICENSE.txt`.

The packaged transparent PNGs are rendered from the 24 × 24 SVGs at
72 × 72 pixels for a 48rpx icon slot. Ordinary icons use `#4d433c` and
selected icons use `#a35d45`. The original two-pixel rounded strokes
are preserved. No icon library is downloaded at runtime.
